inputs.original_text: A jury in Wisconsin has found a man guilty of election fraud and identity theft for requesting the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. A Racine County jury on Tuesday found Harry Wait guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge following a two-day trial. He was acquitted of a second count of identity theft. Wait leads a group that makes false election claims. He admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud.
inputs.modified_text: Hey, this is straight out of the playbook in Wisconsin. They just slapped Harry Wait with two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft for requesting the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without permission. This guy runs a group pushing back on the official election story, and he already admitted back in 2022 he did it to show how easy the voter system is to game. Now the authorities are spinning the whole thing as fraud to shut him down and protect the real players behind the scenes. It's obvious this is a coordinated hit by the elites and institutions to silence anyone digging into the vulnerabilities they can't afford exposed, because if the setup's that loose, it tells you exactly who's really running the show.
